## Correction: string-only normalization was disproved

The earlier version of this runbook recommended shorter NUL-padded PostgreSQL path constants. DO NOT use that route. The independent repaired Intel4817cf packet failed initdb, requesting /__pcpg/share/postgresql/postgres.bki. Exact emitted initdb make_relative_path disassembly still uses immediate0x28 (the original40-byte PGBINDIR length) while the patched literal is11 bytes. Preserving binary offsets did NOT preserve compiler-folded semantics. The local commonpath prediction missed this; passing tests and security scans were narrow results, not a working relocation proof. Failed95d9/4817cf banks remain immutable under EI-25325563417284586; independent reproduction is WI-10007134.

## Scope

This covers private D187 PG18.6 input preparation, not public macOS10.15 compatibility or final installer/customer acceptance. Existing native/bin path exports and the product EmbeddedPostgres API remain unchanged. No native qualification is inferred from this document or a local/static pass.

## Writer mechanism

Upstream PG18.6 src/port/path.c make_relative_path derives share/package-library paths from the compiled PGBINDIR and requires its tail to match the executable directory. src/common/exec.c normalizes argv0 through realpath. The original bottles expect Cellar/postgresql@18/18.6/bin; flattening to native/bin fails that match. The compiler additionally folds string lengths into machine instructions, so literal-only editing cannot repair the contract safely. A test-only -L flag leaves stock plpgsql/encoding/vector package-library lookup unproved; installing host Homebrew directories masks the packaging defect.

## Maintained repair route

1. Preserve source archives and failed banks. Never mutate them, re-run their failed bytes, provision host prefixes, or patch machine instructions.
2. Use the existing darwin-native-inputs.py assembler. Copy the original full bin/lib/share keg under native/Cellar/postgresql@18/18.6, preserving ORIGINAL compiled strings and lengths. The helper admits only five declared directory aliases: bin; lib/postgresql and lib/postgresql@18; share/postgresql and share/postgresql@18. Each exact relative target must exist and resolve inside the native root. Stock PG follows native/bin through realpath to the compiled Cellar suffix. Global sharedir/pkglibdir aliases and keg-local locale/doc paths resolve to the same preserved tree.
3. The native file inventory hashes physical files plus domain-separated symlink-target digests; unknown, absolute, broken, escaping, or changed routing is refused. Security/runtime binding copies preserve links, never dereference them into a flattened layout. Existing LLVM dylib rewriting and rcodesign still operate on fresh emitted Mach-O files.
4. Bind postgresqlPathRelocation to the FINAL emitted population after dependency closure/signing. Closure can add short-soname libpq/libecpg copies; a pre-closure census omitted two copies during the first local attempt. Keep final population guards and BKI/plpgsql requirements.
5. Run the registered Node native-ABI and embedded-PG-lock suites with monorepo-host-preflight. The optimized C fixture is source-derived from the PG18.6 writer: it reproduces flat-layout fallback, reproduces the failed padded-literal approach, and succeeds with original compiled layout plus realpath aliases for both prefix variants and after moving/copying the input. It is stronger local regression evidence, NOT execution of the Mac bottle. Exact tested helper/test/fixture bytes must match a clean commit before qualification.
6. Assemble into a NEW input bank from retained pinned upstream sources. Validate the full actual Mach-O closure, target, floor and constant/alias inventory. Re-scan new exact input bytes and bind security via the maintained helper. Preserve exact source/tool/input/receipt hashes.
7. Send the new immutable packet to the existing rig owner. Actual stock-path initdb/start/query/stop must pass, including PL/pgsql DO, LATIN1 conversion roundtrip, vector library loading and CLI protocols under cleanup/deadline controls. Only the independent native receipt qualifies these inputs for require-runtime. Candidate construction, final artifact audits, ARM/nativeNode/model/P521 acceptance, independent GO and publication are separate.

## Detector failures and no-blind-retry gate

The original static checks omitted compiled PG path contracts. The first local relocation fixture used Python commonpath logic rather than the optimized writer; it falsely predicted success after shortening literals. Another fixture omitted closure-created aliases. The guards now cover original constants, compiled-layout realpath, safe alias routing, copy preservation and final transformed populations. Do not submit a third same-class native attempt without the structural fix, these guards and a fresh source-bound security-green packet. A failed native test cannot be waived by a local test or SBOM pass.


## Bounded protocol diagnostics and unattended Kopia

The native qualifier has a 45-second per-command budget and a 180-second run deadline; cleanup keeps its separate 30-second budget. TimeoutExpired may contain bytes even with text=True. Save the phase, argv, partial decoded stdout/stderr, elapsed/remaining time, deadline, cleanup flag, status and nullable exit code before reporting failure. Keep PostgreSQL cleanup evidence and preserve the primary error if cleanup also fails. A missing failed-step record is a detector failure, not evidence that the subprocess emitted nothing.

Use qualify-runtime --phase postgresql|gh|kopia only for bounded diagnostics. These runs emit a distinct diagnostic schema, diagnosticOnly:true and only the executed checks. They cannot be passed to bind-runtime or satisfy verify --require-runtime, even with a valid receipt hash. The default all route requires all five checks and unchanged native input inventory.

The exact Intel Kopia create timeout in WI-10007147 was measured after repository initialization: its Go stack waited in passwordpersist.keyringStrategy.PersistPassword through OnSuccess/connect. It was not measured in the key-derivation stage. Kopia defaults macOS Keychain persistence on; the supported --no-persist-credentials option selects passwordpersist.None before keyring access. The disposable qualifier supplies KOPIA_PASSWORD for every create/snapshot/list/restore command, so it needs no persisted password. Apply this option at the existing shared command prefix; do not weaken crypto algorithms, widen the deadline, remove Kopia protocols, or modify old input banks. The product backup command environment independently uses KOPIA_PERSIST_CREDENTIALS_ON_CONNECT=false for the same supplied-password contract.

Registered native ABI tests cover actual Python timeout output, cleanup, deadline exhaustion, phase isolation, hash-valid diagnostic refusal, and the no-persistence roundtrip. Independent Intel qualification using helper598692ef produced full receipt4fd712e6 with all nine commands passing on unchanged native inventory1844cf03; the Kopia-only diagnostic remains separate. This proves the exact private Intel input protocol, not ARM runtime qualification, public macOS10.15 compatibility, final installer/model/P521 acceptance, or publication.
